title: Tag der offenen Tür – Waldorfkindergarten Stutensee
description: Der Waldorfkindergarten Stutensee lädt herzlich zum Tag der offenen Tür ein. Besucherinnen und Besucher haben die Gelegenheit, den Kindergarten kennenzulernen, Einblicke in den Alltag mit den Kindern zu gewinnen und die besondere Atmosphäre vor Ort zu erleben.

issues: Missing district tag from available districts list
Tag 'Workshop' may not be fully appropriate for an open house event

_quality.summary: The event entry is well-structured with clear title, precise location, and explicit time. The description is informative. However, the tags are deficient: they do not include a required district from the available districts list, and the 'Workshop' tag is not ideally suited for an open house. No duplicate issues with other events on the same date.
